drafts.text: I’ve reviewed the first two screens. Screen three is waiting on your copy. If you send it by Tuesday, I can finish the review by Thursday; otherwise, I’ll send you a revised date.
We have not confirmed the venue yet.
Mara will review the figures. I’ll update the file after she reports back. If everything is approved, we may be able to send it on Friday.
The studio closes at 5 pm on Mondays. Existing bookings on 23 June may run until 6 pm under a one-off extension approved by the building manager. New bookings cannot be added after 5 pm.
